user.title: Wake the cuff
user.description:
Press **User 1** or **User 2** on the cuff so Bluetooth flashes (about 2 minutes). A new measurement is not required.

Unpair the cuff from medi.connect and any phone. Only one Bluetooth client should hold the bond.

Then tap **Scan**. Home Assistant will listen for BPU26 for {seconds} seconds.

pick_device.title: Select the cuff
pick_device.description: Select the BPU26 to set up.

not_found.title: Cuff not found
not_found.description:
No BPU26 advertisement was seen on the Home Assistant **host** Bluetooth adapter in the last {seconds} seconds.

A **Discovered** card can come from a Bluetooth proxy; pairing cannot. Press **User 1** or **User 2** so Bluetooth flashes while the cuff is next to the Home Assistant machine (not only a proxy), then tap **Scan again**. Or paste the address from host `bluetoothctl` — the Discovered MAC alone is not a host Device1.

bluetooth_confirm.title: Set up Veroval BPU26
bluetooth_confirm.description: Do you want to set up {name} (`{address}`)?

enter_pin.title: Enter the cuff PIN
enter_pin.description:
The cuff should now show a **6-digit PIN**. Enter it below.

Device: {name} (`{address}`)

If no PIN appears, press **User 1** or **User 2** so Bluetooth flashes and try setup again.

user_slot.title: Which user?
user_slot.description:
Choose the cuff memory slot this Home Assistant device should publish (**User 1** or **User 2**, same labels as the buttons). The GATT dump may still contain both slots; only the newest timestamp for this slot is used.

A second person can add the same cuff later and pick the other user.

progress.scanning: Press User 1 or User 2 on the cuff so Bluetooth flashes. Listening for BPU26 ({seconds} seconds)…
progress.connecting: Connecting to {name}. Watch the cuff for a 6-digit PIN…

error.no_devices_found: No BPU26 cuff was found. Press User 1 or User 2 so Bluetooth flashes, wait a few seconds, then submit again — or paste the Bluetooth address from bluetoothctl.
error.invalid_address: Enter a Bluetooth address like AA:BB:CC:DD:EE:FF.
error.invalid_pin: Enter the 6-digit PIN shown on the cuff.
error.pairing_failed: Pairing failed ({error}). Press User 1 or User 2 so Bluetooth flashes, then try again.
error.agent_unavailable: Could not register the Bluetooth pairing agent. Close bluetoothctl if it is open, then try again.
error.device_not_found: Home Assistant’s Discovered card is not enough. BlueZ has no Device1 for this address on the host adapter, so it cannot pair. A Bluetooth proxy cannot enter the cuff PIN. Press User 1 or User 2 near the Home Assistant machine, then tap Scan again.

abort.no_devices_found: No BPU26 cuff was found. Press User 1 or User 2 so Bluetooth flashes (~2 minutes), then try again.
abort.already_in_progress: Configuration flow is already in progress
abort.already_configured: This cuff is already configured for both User 1 and User 2
abort.pairing_not_supported: In-UI pairing requires a Bluetooth adapter on the Home Assistant OS host (Linux BlueZ).
abort.proxy_not_supported: This cuff was only seen via a Bluetooth proxy. Pairing needs the Home Assistant host adapter (built-in or USB). ESPHome Bluetooth Proxy cannot enter the cuff PIN.
abort.agent_unavailable: Could not register the Bluetooth pairing agent. Close bluetoothctl if it is open, then try again.
abort.device_not_found: BlueZ has no Device1 for this address on the host adapter. A Discovered card or Bluetooth proxy is not enough to pair. Press User 1 or User 2 near the Home Assistant machine, then scan again.
abort.pairing_failed: Pairing failed ({error}). Press User 1 or User 2 so Bluetooth flashes, unpair medi.connect, and try again.
abort.stale_advertisement: That BPU26 discovery is from Home Assistant’s advertisement cache, not a live advertise window. Press User 1 or User 2 so Bluetooth flashes, then try again.

force_dump.name: Force data sync
force_dump.description: Connect now and drain stored measurements, ignoring the advertise-window skip. Press User 1 or User 2 so Bluetooth flashes first.

device_id.name: Device
device_id.description: User slot to sync. Leave empty to sync every configured BPU26.
